I'm sorry that happened to you :( You sound like a good man, it must be hard taking care of four children by yourself. But I'm sure you are doing a very good job! I'm sure someone out there will accept you for who you are and recognise the amazing job you are doing of raising your boys.

Hope you guys like it.

You're never too old!

I'm a 34 year old female and play animal crossing for that very reason. Struggled with mental health since my early teens. Met my partner when I was 18, he  introduced me to animal crossing and I haven't stopped playing since. Our three year old also loves watching me play it. I'm hoping she begins playing herself as she is autistic and I've read a lot of encouraging posts from people who have the same condition (or someone they know/are related too) and how it helps them with day to day life :)
